object.attr: as implemented: the line `mellon-mcp serving ...` tells a person reading the client's log which repository the agent works on. Conditioned on the log level and made absolute (review Q9); the test checks the path is absolute.
object.description: When the MCP server starts serving while the log level is `DEBUG` or `INFO`, the MCP server shall write the absolute path of the repository's root folder to standard error.
